A.safe_action: Investigate leaked/long-running DB connections; limit load and restore pool capacity cautiously.
A.verification: DB checkout queue and request error/latency rates recover.

B.likely_cause: Traffic-driven CPU saturation, not DB exhaustion
B.safe_action: Monitor or scale application capacity; do not roll back or change DB pool blindly.
B.verification: CPU and latency stabilize while availability remains high.

C.likely_cause: Missing startup setting after config change; stale DB warning is inconclusive
C.safe_action: Verify current startup logs and configuration; restore last-known-good config/version if confirmed.
C.verification: Startup and health checks pass on the restored configuration.
